lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
topic_title: Transporting Cargo, Safety Chains & Towing Laws
prompt: Under Texas Transportation Code §545.409, what is the maximum legal length of a tow bar or connection chain?

options.text: May not exceed twenty-five feet in length between the vehicles being towed
May not exceed five feet in length between the vehicles being towed
Tow chains have zero statutory length limits under Texas transportation laws
May not exceed fifteen feet in length between the vehicles being towed
